# Every write-path difference the round trip currently produces, by CLASS and NAME.
# Generated by TestWritePathRoundTripHasNoUndeclaredLoss with WRITEPATH_FULL=1
# WRITEPATH_RERECORD=1. Deliberately carries NO counts: a ratchet with a number
# and no names gets re-diagnosed as fresh breakage, and the counts move on every
# corpus promotion while the names do not.
#
# A line here is a CLAIM THAT THE LOSS IS UNDERSTOOD, not permission to ignore it.
# The reasoning for each group lives beside the field in pob/types_saved.go.
